title: Task Adaptive Pretraining of Transformers for Hostility Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a shared task for hostility detection (classification of hate, fake news, defamation, and offensive content). While the definitions of these categories touch on societal issues, the paper's focus is on technical performance (F1 scores) and Task Adaptive Pretraining (TAPT) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
